messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
- The scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-13]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- On 2026-03-09, Team Atlas observed that the scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2]
- The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- As a follow-up to INC-2026-009, the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-08-26 to 2025-11-20; recorded by handover/2025-08-26-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is owned by Team Atlas. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-08-26; recorded by handover/2025-04-03-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- The scheduler's previous single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-13]
- As of 2025-05-09, Tomasz Nowak is the Team Atlas on-call contact for this cycle instead of Priya. [valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-09]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-07, Priya carries the Team Atlas on-call phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-04-07 to 2025-05-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-07]
- As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]

Question: As of now, which team is responsible for the scheduler?
